The strategic location allows guests to admire the lake's beauty while also escaping the cold night temperatures. The dedicated camp staff works tirelessly to ensure a comfortable and unforgettable stay for all visitors. To accommodate the remote setting and prevent any inconveniences, only vegetarian food is served at the camp. Known as a popular filming location, Pangong Lake has been featured in numerous blockbuster movies such as 3 Idiots, Jab Tak Hai Jaan, Sanam Re, and many others.
